name: Advanced Mega Menu
description: A grid-based mega-menu layout builder that lets you fill Drupal menu items with rows and columns of Views, block content, and theme/system blocks through a visual canvas, with an optional REST endpoint for decoupled front-ends.
project_description: Advanced Mega Menu turns ordinary Drupal menus into multi-row, multi-column mega-menu panels. For any top-level item of a mega-menu-enabled menu, an administrator opens a visual "canvas" layout builder (as an AJAX modal from the menu-edit screen or full-screen) and adds rows, splits each row into columns via a chosen column-width mode (auto/equal/fractional/flex/2-6 columns or a custom CSS-class mode), and drops content blocks into columns: Views block displays, custom Block Content entities, or theme/system blocks. Each layout is stored as a `megamenu_content` config entity keyed by the menu link UUID. Per-item display settings control whether to show the mega rows only, the normal child menu links only, or both (with links positioned above or below the grid), plus fallback wrapper/row/column CSS classes. Global settings pick which menus are mega-menu-enabled and configure an optional submenu expand/collapse icon (Unicode symbol or icon-font class, with ARIA labels) and an option to disable the module's own CSS/JS. Rendering is done through a preprocess-menu hook that swaps in the module's `menu--advanced-mega-menu.html.twig` template and builds each item's rows via the MegaMenuRowBuilder / MegaMenuBlockRenderer services. A REST resource (`GET /api/advanced-mega-menu/{menu_id}/{plugin_id}`) returns the rendered mega-menu HTML for decoupled front-ends. All building, editing and deleting is gated by the restricted `administer advanced mega menu` permission.
